result:
{
  "decision": "STOP the min-over-completed-outcomes candidate as a repair path. One narrowly scoped, non-shipping diagnostic is technically justified only as a falsification test of the automorphism-witness idea, restricted to top-level (step 6.3) states, with pre-registered kill criteria. It is plausible that a witness-checked whole-input automorphism predicate removes the test059c failure; it is unlikely to remove test044c/045c/046c. Even complete success would not yield a shippable change at the sparq-canon seam.",

  "evidence_assessment": {
    "what_the_packet_actually_shows": [
      "The candidate changes only lib/RDFC10Sync.js of rdf-canonize 5.0.0 and is driven by an external replay-DFS (explore.cjs). 218 process runs, all exit zero; exit zero is explicitly not a canonicalization success.",
      "Saved 12 variants unify to one document under the candidate; the first-only control reproduces the 2-document split. That is a real, reproducible demonstration that the observed relabel divergence originates at tie points the candidate enumerates (step 6.3 stable-sort ties and equal-minimum-path recursive issuers), not elsewhere.",
      "W3C: 81/85 positives byte-unchanged, negative test074c still errors (with a different error type/text), 4 positives newly exhaust experimental limits. This is a genuine regression, not a flake: 044c/045c/046c blow the 4000 global HNDQ counter with 0 leaves; 059c blows the 64-execution cap after 36 leaves."
    ],
    "what_it_does_not_show": [
      "test059c: 36 observed leaves with 1 distinct document is roughly 5% of the 6! = 720 top-level orderings implied by six interchangeable components. Equal observed leaves are not evidence about the 684 unexplored orderings. The packet correctly refuses to return a partial minimum.",
      "No completed case exercised a recursive multi-issuer tie (recursive_coverage.completed_cases_with_recursive_choices = 0). The entire recursive branch of the candidate is unvalidated on any successful outcome; 044c/045c/046c reached the hook and died there.",
      "No proof, and no test, that the *set* of leaves the candidate exposes is itself invariant under relabeling. The objective 'lexicographically least completed document' is defined operationally by this implementation's tie points, not by a structural property of the isomorphism class. The seeded corpus and saved variants are relabel-tested; the W3C corpus is not relabel-tested at all.",
      "Byte-compatibility is asserted only against this frozen baseline pair on 86 packaged entries. On the saved fixture the candidate deliberately changes bytes for the 'original' labeling (it returns the _:c14n2 _:c14n3 ordering, not the baseline _:c14n3 _:c14n2). That is unavoidable for any repair of a genuine ambiguity, but it is a real interop break for consumers that hash canonical bytes."
    ],
    "correct_calls_by_the_candidate_author": [
      "Refusing to return a minimum from an incomplete search, and treating leaf-count agreement as non-evidence.",
      "Noting that exact map equality across renamings is not required for legitimate automorphisms. This is provably right: if a labeled dataset D admits a nontrivial automorphism sigma with sigma(D) = D, then relabel-equivariance of an injective map M would force M(b) = M(sigma b), which is impossible. Only the output document can be relabel-invariant; the map can only be required to be deterministic and consistent with the returned document.",
      "Retaining the strict-greater-than prefix pruning and not weakening the success property."
    ],
    "prune_soundness_note_verified_by_inspection": "The existing lexicographic pruning (path > chosenPath at a prefix) cannot discard an equal-minimum permutation: if a prefix P > C then every extension of P is > C. So the candidate's chosenIssuers collection does capture all equal-minimum-path issuers reachable under the current nested choices. This part of the construction is defensible; it is not where the approach fails."
  },

  "blocking_findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1-search-tree-not-state-indexed",
      "finding": "The exposed tree is indexed by choice-index prefixes, not by algorithm states. Every branch re-executes the whole canonicalization from scratch and re-derives identical states. This is the dominant cost in 044c/045c/046c (about 182, 111, 182 HNDQ calls per execution, 22/36/22 executions).",
      "why_it_blocks": "Any memoization proposal is premature until the state key exists. At step 6.3 the continuation is a pure function of (ordered canonical issuer list, D); inside hashNDegreeQuads it is not, because the continuation lives in the JS call stack (parent's remaining hash buckets, accumulated digest state, ancestor frames). Recursive-level memoization or pruning is therefore not well-founded without a CPS/explicit-continuation refactor, which is far beyond a bounded experiment."
    },
    {
      "id": "F2-budget-semantics-corrupted",
      "finding": "A single global HNDQ counter (4000, matching production Simple semantics) is charged for replay work. Acceptance then depends on exploration breadth and pruning efficiency, not on input structure.",
      "why_it_blocks": "Two conforming implementations with different pruning would accept/reject different inputs at the same nominal budget. This converts a work bound into an implementation-defined acceptance predicate. B5 already records that an ambiguity rejection is a new rejection for a previously accepted input; this generalizes it to every symmetric input. Raising the budget is excluded by the constraints, and would not fix the semantics."
    },
    {
      "id": "F3-objective-is-implementation-defined",
      "finding": "The candidate minimizes over completed documents reachable while still forcing hashNDegreeQuads to return the spec-minimum path (non-minimal-path issuers are discarded). The objective is therefore 'min over the ties this code happens to expose', not a mathematical canonical form.",
      "why_it_blocks": "Discarding non-minimal paths is necessary to keep returned HNDQ hashes spec-conformant, and is defensible because chosenPath is structurally determined. But the relabel-invariance claim then requires proving that the exposed tie set is relabel-invariant. That proof does not exist, and none of the four failing fixtures nor any W3C fixture was relabel-tested under the candidate."
    },
    {
      "id": "F4-seam-cannot-host-the-repair",
      "finding": "Production canonicalizes through rdf_canon 0.15.3 (Rust). The candidate is a fork of the JS reference. sparq-difftest/src/iso.rs calls rdf-canon directly with its own 100000-call budget, and sparq-canon/src/rdf12.rs is a separate nonstandard implementation.",
      "why_it_blocks": "No seam-level change in lib.rs can implement this. Adoption would require vendoring/forking the dependency and deliberately emitting non-RDFC bytes on ambiguous inputs, diverging from every deployed RDFC-1.0 implementation, with no accepted erratum. Consumers that sign or commit to canonical bytes (sparq-vc suite.rs hash_data, sparq-zk commit.rs/dual_leaf.rs/trace.rs, wasm Dataset.equals/toCanonical) would split from unpatched peers on exactly the inputs the repair touches."
    },
    {
      "id": "F5-rust-ordered-issuer-hazard",
      "finding": "B6 records that the Rust side restores temporary issuer order via a BTreeMap keyed on bN strings, so at 11+ temporary labels b10 precedes b2, i.e. lexical rather than chronological order.",
      "why_it_blocks": "The proposed predicate depends on aligning *ordered* temporary issuer old-id lists. If the port compares lexically-ordered lists, the alignment check compares the wrong sequences and the 'witness' is unsound. Any port must resolve B6 first; the JS-only result does not transfer. This remains an unconfirmed source lead, not a demonstrated failure."
    },
    {
      "id": "F6-witness-search-is-GI-hard-and-circular",
      "finding": "Deciding branch equivalence in general means deciding dataset automorphism, which is graph-isomorphism-hard, i.e. the same problem canonicalization is solving.",
      "why_it_blocks": "Only *verification* of an explicitly supplied sigma is cheap (O(|D| log |D|)). Any cheap *search* heuristic (equal HNDQ hash, equal first-degree hash, equal observed leaves) is exactly the unproven shortcut prohibited here: the RDFC hashes are lossy by construction (first-degree hashing collapses identity to _:a/_:z), so hash equality is precisely the condition that creates ties and is necessary-but-not-sufficient for automorphy."
    },
    {
      "id": "F7-map-selection-under-pruning",
      "finding": "explore.cjs keeps the first leaf on strict Buffer.compare < 0, so among automorphic maps yielding the identical minimal document the returned map is exploration-order dependent. Pruning changes exploration order.",
      "why_it_blocks": "This does not violate any provable invariance (see evidence_assessment), but it can change the returned issued-identifier map relative to the frozen baseline on symmetric inputs, which is directly checked by the 21 RDFC10MapTest entries and consumed by sparq-zk trace.rs leaf indices. Map bytes must be re-verified, not assumed."
    }
  ],

  "sound_pruning_predicate_or_null": {
    "name": "witness-checked whole-input automorphism equivalence of top-level continuation states",
    "applies_at": "step 6.3 only (choice among remaining equal-hash results). Explicitly NOT at the recursive equal-minimum-path issuer choice, see restriction below.",
    "state_model": "A top-level state is S = (D, K) where D is the input quad list with multiplicity and K is the ordered canonical issuer as a list [(node_0, c14n0), ..., (node_{m-1}, c14n(m-1))]. Justification required by obligation O1: after step 5, all other mutable state (blankNodeInfo first-degree hashes) is immutable, so the remaining computation is a function of (D, K) plus budget counters.",
    "predicate": "S_A = (D, K_A) and S_B = (D, K_B), reached at the same enumeration depth, are equivalent iff there exists an explicit bijection sigma on the blank labels of D such that: (C1) sigma(D) = D as a quad multiset, sigma fixing all ground terms and acting in subject, object and graph-name positions, multiplicities preserved; (C2) |K_A| = |K_B| = m and sigma(K_A[i].node) = K_B[i].node for every i < m, so canonical indices correspond position-for-position; (C3) the remaining results of the current equal-hash group correspond elementwise under sigma on their *ordered* temporary-issuer old-id lists and have equal hashes.",
    "consequence_claimed": "outcomes(S_A) = outcomes(S_B) as sets of canonical documents, hence the minimum coincides and S_B may be discarded. The document-level equality is the strong part: if final maps satisfy M_B = M_A o sigma^{-1} with sigma(D) = D, then the serialized-and-sorted N-Quads are byte-identical, not merely isomorphic.",
    "why_whole_input_and_not_group_local": "Later groups' hashRelatedBlankNode results read the canonical ids of already-assigned nodes and the first-degree hashes of unassigned ones, and the candidate's own telemetry shows every 059c top choice is crossGroup (28/28), i.e. the chosen issuer covers nodes outside the current idList. A group-local isomorphism is therefore not sufficient; sigma must be an automorphism of the entire input.",
    "witness_construction_rule": "Candidate sigma is not searched for freely. Rule W1: elementwise map between the two results' ordered old-id lists, extended by identity elsewhere. Rule W2 (optional, bounded): extend the partial map by constraint propagation over D with a hard step cap; abandon on cap. In both cases the witness must be verified against C1-C3 before pruning. If no witness verifies, the branch is explored. Pruning is sound-but-incomplete by construction.",
    "restriction_for_recursive_ties": "At a recursive tie inside hashNDegreeQuads, K_A = K_B (no canonical assignment happens during a top-level HNDQ), and the continuation additionally includes the enclosing frames. Pruning is only admissible if sigma additionally (C4) fixes every node in dom(K) pointwise, (C5) maps the whole ordered domain of issuer A onto that of issuer B, and (C6) leaves every already-fixed chosenPath string and every already-materialized hashToRelated bucket in every ancestor frame invariant. C4-C6 are a congruence requirement that the current implementation does not expose; they cannot be checked from the data explore.cjs collects.",
    "predicted_yield": "W1 will typically succeed for 059c-style choices (disjoint, literally identical components; identity extension is an automorphism) and typically fail for 044c/045c/046c-style recursive ties, where the induced partial map on 2-3 issued nodes forces movement of unissued neighbours and identity extension is not an automorphism. Overlapping or unequal-length issuer domains (the packet's topOverlapping flag, 3/3 on the two-component corpus) make W1 inapplicable outright."
  },

  "proof_obligations": [
    "O1 State sufficiency: prove by code inspection that after step 5, the remaining computation depends only on (D, K) and budget counters; in particular that blankNodeInfo hashes are computed once and never refreshed, and that no other cross-iteration mutable state exists.",
    "O2 Equivariance lemma: for sigma satisfying C1-C2, prove hashFirstDegreeQuads(b) = hashFirstDegreeQuads(sigma b); hashRelatedBlankNode(r,q,I,pos) = hashRelatedBlankNode(sigma r, sigma q, sigma·I, pos) for corresponding issuers; and that hashNDegreeQuads returns equal hashes with equal-minimum-path issuer sets corresponding under sigma, including under the strict-> prefix pruning and including the recursion.",
    "O3 Bisimulation: prove the predicate is preserved by every successor step of the enumeration, so that outcome sets, not just first outcomes, coincide. Induction on remaining choices.",
    "O4 Output identity: prove that if M_B = M_A o sigma^{-1} and sigma(D) = D as a multiset, then the sorted serialized documents are byte-identical, covering blank graph names, duplicate quads, and the trailing newline convention.",
    "O5 Verification correctness and cost: prove the sigma check is decided exactly (no hashing shortcut) and in near-linear time, and that a failed verification never prunes.",
    "O6 Objective preservation: prove pruning cannot remove the unique minimum, i.e. every pruned branch's outcome set is a subset of a retained branch's outcome set.",
    "O7 Tie-set relabel invariance (currently missing and independent of pruning): prove that the *set* of exposed choice points and of collected equal-minimum-path issuers is invariant under bijective relabeling of D, otherwise the min-over-leaves objective is not a function of the isomorphism class.",
    "O8 Budget accounting: define how pruned work is charged. A memoized or pruned implementation consumes fewer HNDQ calls than the spec algorithm, so under a fixed global bound it accepts inputs the reference rejects and vice versa. Either the bound must be redefined (excluded here) or the acceptance-set change must be stated as an explicit interoperability consequence.",
    "O9 Ordered-issuer alignment: prove C3/C5 are checked against chronological issuance order, and demonstrate that a lexical restoration (B6, b10 before b2 at 11+ labels) breaks the check; construct the 11+ temporary-label fixture before any port."
  ],

  "bounded_next_experiment_or_stop": {
    "verdict": "stop-unless-falsified: at most ONE further scratch experiment, framed as a falsification test, not as an attempt to make the candidate pass",
    "scope": "Add witness-checked automorphism dedup at step 6.3 only, using rule W1 (identity extension) with full C1-C3 verification. Do not implement recursive-level pruning. Do not implement memoization. Do not touch budgets, limits, properties, production, or the dependency.",
    "primary_measurement": "For each of the four failing fixtures, and for all 86 W3C entries, record: (a) at every choice point, whether a W1 witness verifies; (b) surviving branch count; (c) HNDQ calls consumed relative to the frozen baseline's single run; (d) output bytes and map bytes versus baseline.",
    "predicted_outcome": "059c collapses to a single branch (about 18 HNDQ calls, baseline document, and probably the baseline map because branch index 0 follows the stable-sorted insertion order). 044c/045c/046c are predicted NOT to be fixed, because their 21-35 choice points are recursive and W1 cannot extend across unissued neighbours.",
    "pre_registered_stop_criteria": [
      "Stop the entire approach if any W3C output or map byte differs from the frozen baseline.",
      "Stop if 044c/045c/046c still exhaust, or if their W1 witness rate at recursive ties is below 100 percent (anything less leaves exponential residue: 2^k branches at k unwitnessed ties).",
      "Stop if total HNDQ calls on any completing fixture exceed twice the frozen baseline's single-run count.",
      "Stop if any negative control below fails.",
      "Stop if O1 or O4 cannot be discharged by inspection within the experiment's fixed work limit."
    ],
    "work_limits": "Reuse the existing frozen protocol unchanged (4000 global HNDQ calls, 64 executions, 1000 ms per input, 3 s per case, 140 s per run). Do not tune, raise, or add limits. No second candidate, no retries.",
    "if_it_succeeds": "Even a clean pass is only a scratch demonstration that the tie ambiguity is automorphism-only on this corpus. It is not a repair proposal. The correct venue would be upstream (rdf-canonize and rdf-canon) and the W3C RDF canonicalization group, since the defect is in the specification's underdetermined step 6.3 ordering, not in the Sparq seam.",
    "if_it_fails": "Stop this line entirely. The remaining defensible work is diagnostic and orthogonal: the B6 11+ temporary-label fixture, and a decision by root about whether the known relabel ambiguity is documented as a limitation rather than repaired locally."
  },

  "required_negative_controls": [
    "Load-bearing witness control: run a deliberately unsound variant that prunes on equal HNDQ hash alone (no sigma verification) and show it produces a wrong or different document on at least one fixture. If it does not, the verification is vacuous on this corpus and proves nothing.",
    "Pruning-neutrality control: for every case that completes both with and without pruning, assert byte-identical output AND byte-identical map. Any difference falsifies O6/O4 or exposes F7.",
    "Trivial-witness control: assert sigma = identity is rejected between genuinely distinct branches (it must fail C2 or C3).",
    "Non-automorphic tie control: a fixture whose tied results are hash-equal but not automorphic (e.g. 033c-style disjoint but structurally distinguishable pairs) must still explore both branches and must still differ from the first-only control.",
    "First-only control retained on all 12 saved variants: it must still yield 2 distinct documents, proving the search is still active and the 12-variant unification is not an artifact of pruning.",
    "Relabel and quad-order controls that the previous phase omitted: for every W3C entry and every seeded corpus item, run N bijective relabelings and N quad-order permutations and assert output byte-equality. This is the property actually at stake and it has never been exercised on the W3C corpus.",
    "Negative entry test074c must still error without output or map; record that the error type/text still differs from baseline (not an error-API compatibility claim).",
    "Budget accounting control: report HNDQ calls per fixture with and without pruning under the same single global counter."
  ],

  "production_change_approved": false,

  "confidence": {
    "test059c_removable_by_the_predicate": "moderate-to-high (the components are literally identical, so W1 verifies and 720 orderings collapse to 1; this reasoning is from the fixture text, not from execution)",
    "test044c_045c_046c_removable": "low (recursive ties, partial and non-extendable issuer domains, plus replay cost under a global counter; the tree is bimodal - either every recursive tie is witnessed or the residue is exponential)",
    "approach_yields_a_shippable_change": "very low (F4 alone: the seam cannot host it, difftest bypasses it, and adoption means deliberate non-RDFC bytes without an erratum)",
    "assessment_of_the_packet_itself": "high that the NO-GO call and the refusal to return partial minima are correct; high that the four failures are real regressions",
    "basis": "reading of the supplied diff, explore.cjs, fixture texts and telemetry only"
  },

  "limitations": [
    "I executed nothing, built nothing, and verified no hash, commit, provenance or file identity. Every count, hash, exit code and byte string above is taken from the supplied untrusted packet.",
    "My branch-count reasoning for 059c (6! orderings, 18 HNDQ calls per run) and for 044c/045c/046c (about 182/111/182 calls per execution) is derived arithmetically from the reported statistics and fixture text, not measured.",
    "My reading of automorphism structure in 044c/045c/046c is from the N-Quads text alone; I did not compute automorphism groups and could be wrong about which ties are automorphic. That is precisely why the proposed experiment is a measurement with kill criteria rather than a plan.",
    "I did not review IdentifierIssuer, Permuter, NQuads, MessageDigest, or the Rust rdf-canon internals; O1, O2 and O9 could fail on code I have not seen. The dedup on the private field _existing via JSON.stringify is a portability and correctness hazard I flag but did not analyze.",
    "I make no claim about the RDFC-1.0 specification's intent, no claim that an erratum is warranted, and no claim about downstream deployment exploitability. The consumer inventory is a static source scan, not a call graph or external consumer census.",
    "Nothing here authorizes a production patch, a dependency change, a budget change, a fixture change, a quarantine, or a property relaxation. The candidate remains STOPPED."
  ]
}
